Dashed: logical IDs; multiplicity is not an integrity guarantee.<br>UNIQUE(seriesId,episodeNumber) orders episodes. ViewSession PK is (userId,reelId,playbackSessionId).<br>ViewEvent UNIQUE(userId,reelId,playbackSessionId,sequence). Outbox aggregate and playback-session correlation links have no declared FK.<br>Dashed-link multiplicities are intended or possible associations; a stored ID does not guarantee the target exists." vertex="1" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontColor=#687782;fontFamily=Arial;"><mxGeometry as="geometry" x="35" y="1574.992" width="2425.968" height="135"/></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>

div.div:
Solid entity links: declared PG FK / Mongo ORM. Dashed: logical IDs; multiplicity is not an integrity guarantee.
UNIQUE(seriesId,episodeNumber) orders episodes. ViewSession PK is (userId,reelId,playbackSessionId).
ViewEvent UNIQUE(userId,reelId,playbackSessionId,sequence). Outbox aggregate and playback-session correlation links have no declared FK.
Dashed-link multiplicities are intended or possible associations; a stored ID does not guarantee the target exists.
